notes.zh: 既可作为随机遗址出现（《远古遗物》，权重100，不宜居的常规星球），也由星系初始化器 hauer_system_initializer 在拥有《远古遗物》时创建（common/solar_system_initializers/federations_initializers.txt:180）。
notes.en: It can appear as a random site (Ancient Relics, weight 100 on uninhabitable regular planets) and is also created by the system initializer hauer_system_initializer when Ancient Relics is present (common/solar_system_initializers/federations_initializers.txt:180).

texts.zh:
只有通过考古论证和想象才能在如今已经荒芜的[From.Planet.GetName]表面上重构出那个曾经繁盛一时的文明。岁月的流逝是残酷无情的，即使是曾经最为坚不可摧的建筑，如今也只化作一地的尘埃。

但在那深不可测的地下，有一个怪异的信号正在脉动着。一座神秘的信标仿佛呼唤着我们的调查和发掘。
texts.en:
Only through archaeological proof and imagination can one depict a once flourishing civilization on the now desolate surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. So unkind has the passage of time been, that even the sturdiest buildings have been grinded down to little more than dust.

But from deep underground a strange signal is pulsing. A mysterious beacon yearning for investigation and uncovering.

texts.zh:
当挖掘团队越来越接近深处的信标时，无法忽视的死亡感触突然神秘地在挖掘团队中蔓延。随着更多的泥土和石头被清除，一个坚定的观念在每个人的脑海中徘徊：

生命转瞬即逝。总有一天这一切都会结束……
texts.en:
A sudden and undeniable sense of mortality has mysteriously crept upon the excavation team as they get closer to the beacon in the depths. As more dirt and rock is removed, an unescapable notion lingers in the back of everyone's mind:

Life is fleeting. Someday all this is going to end...

texts.zh:
信号来源是一座外星墓碑，上面镌刻着奇异的符号。翻译文本充其量只算是略有眉目。这些符号提及了一位举足轻重的人物，其一生的伟业值得铭记与崇拜，整个文明都处于哀伤之中。翻译文本接近末尾时变得十分怪异，诉说体液因悲伤从身体中流出，随后又因天气条件而消逝。

只有全文的最后一部分得到了成功翻译：

‘死亡的时刻到了。’
texts.en:
The source of the signal is an alien tombstone inscribed with strange symbols. The translation is sketchy at best. It speaks of a person of great importance, of a life's work worthy of remembrance and veneration, and of a civilization in mourning. Towards the end the translation becomes very odd, speaking of grief-induced leakage of bodily-fluids, and their subsequent dissipation due to weather conditions.

Only the very last part was successfully translated:

'Time to die.'

summary.text:
# 永不遗忘 / Never Forget

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:1402；events/federations_events_1.txt:2377；common/solar_system_initializers/federations_initializers.txt:180 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics；初始化器在 federations 文件 (initializer in a Federations file) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

既可作为随机遗址出现（《远古遗物》，权重100，不宜居的常规星球），也由星系初始化器 hauer_system_initializer 在拥有《远古遗物》时创建（common/solar_system_initializers/federations_initializers.txt:180）。

It can appear as a random site (Ancient Relics, weight 100 on uninhabitable regular planets) and is also created by the system initializer hauer_system_initializer when Ancient Relics is present (common/solar_system_initializers/federations_initializers.txt:180).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

地下传来神秘信标的脉冲；越接近信号，考察队越感到“生命短暂”，最终找到的是一块刻着悼念铭文的墓碑。

1. 深渊灯塔：被时间磨成尘土的文明，地下有信标在脉动
2. 时日无多：考察队被挥之不去的死亡感笼罩
3. 无比明亮：信号源是一块外星墓碑，铭文只译出“该死去了”（永久修正“失落时刻的纪念物”）

A beacon pulses from deep underground; the closer the team gets, the stronger the sense that life is fleeting — the signal is a tombstone.

1. Beacon in the Depth: a civilisation ground to dust by time, a beacon pulsing below
2. Running out of Time: the dig team is overcome by a sense of mortality
3. So very, very brightly: the signal is an alien tombstone; only "Time to die" translates cleanly (permanent modifier lost_moment_memento)

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊的文明差异。 / No empire-specific variants beyond the reward wording.
- 掷骰失败时使用多个遗址共用的事件池 site_echoes_inside_random_events（与“内部回响”相同）。 / Failed rolls draw from the pool site_echoes_inside_random_events, shared by several sites (the same as The Echoes Inside).
